ops.title: Codex rollout format spec — P0 verification findings (source rust-v0.144.5 + 4790-file corpus)
ops.body:
# Codex rollout format — verified ground truth (P0, 2026-07-19)

Sources: openai/codex at tag rust-v0.144.5 (source lane, file:line cites into that checkout) + full local corpus sweep (4790 files, 2026-01-19→2026-07-19, cli_version 0.42.0→0.144.5). Fixtures: `tests/testdata/codex/` (10 files, synthesized content, verified + blockers fixed).

## Envelope & writer
- `RolloutLine { timestamp: String, #[serde(flatten)] item: RolloutItem }` (protocol.rs:3326). Timestamp is ALWAYS `[date]T[time].[3-digit subsec]Z` UTC — hardcoded format, offset form structurally unreachable (recorder.rs ~1826). Corpus: 24,259/24,259 sampled end in Z.
- **Append-only holds**: every writer opens `.append(true)`, zero `truncate(true)`; resume appends; fork slices in-memory into a NEW file; compaction only appends. One representation nuance: a background zstd worker round-trips cold `.jsonl` ↔ `.jsonl.zst` (lossless; discovery must expect `.jsonl.zst` for cold sessions).
- Rollout code lives in its own crate `codex-rs/rollout/` (moved out of core).

## Top-level types (exactly 7 observed, corpus-complete)
response_item, event_msg, turn_context, session_meta, inter_agent_communication_metadata (0.144.1+ only), world_state (0.144.1+), compacted (0.75.0+, intermittent). NOT top-level: ghost_snapshot (a response_item payload type, 0.75.0–0.125.0 then gone), sub_agent_activity (an event_msg payload type, 0.144.1+), internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough (a nested FIELD `{turn_id}` on every response_item since 0.42.0 — **explicit turn correlation for response items**; token_count has no such field).

## response_item payload types (version spans)
reasoning (0.75+), function_call/function_call_output, custom_tool_call/custom_tool_call_output (0.75+), message (0.42+, roles user/assistant/**developer**), agent_message (0.144.1+, author/recipient multi-agent shape), web_search_call (0.75–0.142.5), ghost_snapshot (0.75–0.125), tool_search_call/output (0.124–0.142.5), image_generation_call (rare). `function_call.name` includes `spawn_agent` (namespace `collaboration`) — how children are spawned.

## event_msg payload types
token_count (0.42+), agent_message (0.75+; `phase` null pre-0.107.0, then `commentary`|`final_answer` — MessagePhase enum is exactly those two), agent_reasoning (0.75–0.144.2 then gone), sub_agent_activity (0.144.1+, kind ∈ started|interacted|interrupted), task_started (**earliest 0.98.0** — the EventMsg variant existed since v0.1 but persistence began 0.98.0), user_message, task_complete (0.98.0+), exec_command_end (0.107–0.128 only), patch_apply_end, web_search_end, context_compacted, mcp_tool_call_end, thread_settings_applied (0.144.1+), item_completed, collab_agent_spawn_end/collab_waiting_end/collab_close_end (0.107–0.125 — an ABANDONED earlier multi-agent v1), image_generation_end, view_image_tool_call, thread_rolled_back. `EventMsg::Error` is NEVER persisted → no durable failure marker exists anywhere.

## Lifecycle (probe spine)
- task_started = `TurnStartedEvent{turn_id, trace_id?, started_at? (epoch s), model_context_window?, collaboration_mode_kind}`, serde rename "task_started" (alias "turn_started").
- task_complete = `TurnCompleteEvent{turn_id, last_agent_message?, completed_at? (epoch s), duration_ms?, time_to_first_token_ms?}` — NO success field.
- turn_aborted = `TurnAbortedEvent{turn_id?, reason ∈ Interrupted|Replaced|ReviewEnded|BudgetLimited, completed_at?, duration_ms?}` — persisted since **0.42.0** (predates task_started by many versions; intermittent).
- turn_context re-fires 1–2× per turn normally (0 in 7/134, up to 59 in early 0.100.x); NEVER a turn boundary. Compaction sequence (same turn continues, same turn_id): Compacted{message, replacement_history?, window ids} → WorldState{full:true} (if baseline) → TurnContext (if injected) → TokenCount → event_msg context_compacted (legacy mode).
- token_count: `RolloutItem::EventMsg` discards the outer `Event{id}` envelope at persistence → NO turn/request association, positional only. v1 = transcript-level aggregate.

## Identity & children
- SessionMeta carries `id` (own ThreadId = filename uuid suffix), `session_id` (shared root — non-root agents inherit agent_control.session_id()), `parent_thread_id`, `forked_from_id` — all in ONE row per source. BUT the corpus shows **two-row session_meta heads in ~50% of ALL codex_exec files since 0.89.0** (row0=own, thread_source usually `subagent`, forked from row1=`user`; adjacent lines 0-1 in 18/19; one mid-stream re-injection outlier at line 124). Filename matches row0.id 19/19. **Parser rule: first session_meta row wins identity; tolerate N rows.**
- Two-row head ≠ multi-agent — it's a general threading convention. Genuine multi-agent marker: inter_agent_communication_metadata rows (0.144.1+), each immediately followed (same timestamp, 450/450) by its paired response_item agent_message{author,recipient}. trigger_turn=true opens a turn (within 2–7 lines of task_started); false = mid-turn relay. A child's own transcript has exactly one, always trigger_turn=true.

## Echoes (dedup contract)
Legacy history mode is the ONLY mode on disk (local thread store rejects Paginated) → event_msg user_message/agent_message echoes are the everyday case. Twinning by content hash: user_message ~100% twinned; agent_message untwinned 72% in child transcripts, 28% in orchestrators, ~8% baseline in plain files. Echo text matches response_item message[role=assistant] only — NEVER response_item agent_message (those are not echo twins). → pair-verified per-event dedup is correct; un-twinned echoes carry content.

## Tools
- Shell tool is `function_call exec_command` (ToolSpec::Function) in ALL vintages incl. 0.144.x — args JSON string with cmd/workdir.
- `custom_tool_call` = ToolSpec::Freeform only: exactly `exec` (code-mode Lark-grammar meta-tool, codex_code_mode::PUBLIC_TOOL_NAME) and `apply_patch`. input is a free-form STRING 100% (0/2265 parse as JSON). `status` = item-streaming state; 100% of persisted rows say "completed" (rows written once item streaming completes — a dangling call on disk = status completed + missing output row). Pairing by call_id ~99.9% (63/65166 unpaired = truncation).
- Units: envelope UTC-Z strings; started_at/completed_at epoch SECONDS; duration_ms/time_to_first_token_ms ms; occurred_at_ms epoch MILLISECONDS.

## Fixture inventory (tests/testdata/codex/)
101=old vintage (instructions field, exec_command, no lifecycle) · 202=mid 0.125.0 (task brackets, ghost_snapshot, permission_profile) · 303=current 0.144.x (custom_tool_call exec, twinned echoes, patch_apply_end multifile, world_state) · 404=child (two-row head, trigger_turn, un-twinned echoes, sub_agent_activity) · 050a=dangling call · 050b=abort after dangling · 050c=multi-turn · 050d=compaction mid-turn · 050e=MCP round-trip · 060f=environment_context wrapper. Post-verify fixes applied: phase→commentary/final_answer, sub_agent_activity.kind→interacted, ghost_snapshot removed from 303, originator→codex_exec, dangling custom_tool_call status→completed.

Full lane reports (13KB serde-level persisted_schema incl. field lists): session task output `wulamv3lg` (this session only); the fixtures + this note are the durable contract.
